name: Animals After Death
overview: Scripture reveals that animals are living beings with life and soul, as God has given them life and sustenance just as He has to mankind (Genesis 1:30; Job 12:10). While humans and animals share the common experience of physical death, Scripture distinguishes the destiny of their spirits, noting that the spirit of man ascends upward, whereas the spirit of the beast returns downward to the earth (Ecclesiastes 3:19, 3:21). God’s care extends to both man and beast, affirming the value of animals within His creation, yet the Bible does not indicate that animals share in the eternal life granted to humans through Christ.
